title: 12 Señales de una Relación Emocionalmente Sana
summary: 12 señales de una relación emocionalmente sana: comunicación, confianza, respeto, autonomía y apoyo mutuo. Ejemplos cotidianos y consejos para fortalece...
body_text: Solemos hablar mucho de las señales de alerta en una relación, y está bien saber reconocerlas. Pero mucho menos hablamos de cómo se ve una relación sana. Y no saber cómo se siente lo bueno hace difícil construirlo o reconocer cuándo lo tenemos delante. Una relación emocionalmente sana no es una sin conflictos ni una donde todo es perfecto. Es una donde ambos se sienten seguros, respetados y libres de ser quienes son, incluso cuando no están de acuerdo. Aquí verás doce señales de una relación emocionalmente sana, con ejemplos cotidianos y algunas ideas para fortalecerla. Sirve para las relaciones de pareja, pero muchas de estas señales aplican también a las amistades y a los vínculos familiares. En Resumen Lo que encontrarás en este artículo: Doce señales de una relación sana: comunicación, confianza, respeto, autonomía y apoyo mutuo Ejemplos cotidianos de cómo se ven estas señales en la práctica Por qué el conflicto bien manejado es parte de una relación sana, no lo contrario Consejos para fortalecer el vínculo y cuándo buscar apoyo profesional ¿Qué Hace Sana a una Relación? Una relación sana no se mide por la ausencia de problemas, sino por cómo se enfrentan. Todas las parejas discuten, tienen diferencias y atraviesan momentos difíciles. La diferencia está en la base sobre la que se construye el vínculo. Esa base tiene que ver con seguridad emocional: sentir que puedes ser tú, expresar lo que piensas y equivocarte sin miedo a que el vínculo se rompa o a que te castiguen por ello. Los especialistas de Selia observan que muchas personas nunca vieron de cerca una relación sana, así que les cuesta identificar cómo se siente. Reconocer estas señales ayuda a construirlas de forma consciente. 12 Señales de una Relación Emocionalmente Sana 1. Se comunican con honestidad Pueden decir lo que sienten sin miedo a la reacción del otro. No tienen que adivinar ni caminar en puntillas. En la práctica : "me molestó esto" se puede decir sin que estalle una guerra. 2. Confían el uno en el otro No hay necesidad de revisar el teléfono ni de controlar cada paso. La confianza es la norma, no algo que se exige a la fuerza. 3. Se respetan aun cuando no están de acuerdo Pueden pensar distinto sin descalificarse. El desacuerdo no se convierte en insulto ni en desprecio. 4. Mantienen su autonomía Cada uno conserva su espacio, sus amistades y sus intereses. Estar juntos no significa fusionarse ni renunciar a la propia vida. 5. Resuelven los conflictos sin destruirse Discuten, sí, pero buscan entenderse, no ganar. No usan el dolor del otro como arma ni sacan a relucir todo el pasado en cada pelea. 6. Ponen y respetan límites Un "no" se acepta sin castigo ni chantaje. Los límites de cada uno se toman en serio, no como un rechazo personal. 7. Se apoyan en los momentos difíciles Cuando uno cae, el otro sostiene. Hay una sensación real de estar en el mismo equipo frente a los problemas. 8. Celebran los logros del otro El éxito de uno no genera competencia ni envidia, sino alegría genuina. Se impulsan en lugar de frenarse. 9. Se sienten libres de ser vulnerables Pueden mostrarse frágiles, llorar o admitir un error sin miedo a que se use en su contra más adelante. 10. Reparan después de una discusión Tras un conflicto, buscan reconectar: piden disculpas, retoman la conversación con calma. No dejan que el resentimiento se acumule. 11. Comparten responsabilidades de forma justa El peso de la relación no recae siempre en uno. Las decisiones y las tareas se reparten con un sentido de equidad. 12. Crecen como individuos, no solo como pareja La relación impulsa a cada uno a ser mejor versión de sí mismo, no lo encoge. Hay espacio para el crecimiento personal dentro del vínculo. ‍ ¿Cómo Fortalecer tu Relación? Si al leer la lista sentiste que a tu relación le faltan algunas señales, no lo tomes como una sentencia. Estas cosas se pueden cultivar. Empieza por la comunicación . Muchas relaciones no tienen un problema de amor, sino de cómo se hablan. Practicar la escucha activa, es decir, escuchar para entender y no para responder, cambia el tono de las conversaciones difíciles. Cuida los pequeños gestos . El vínculo se sostiene menos en los grandes momentos y más en el día a día: preguntar cómo estuvo el día, agradecer, mostrar interés genuino. Y respeta el espacio individual . Una relación sana no exige renunciar a quien eres. Cultivar tu propia vida también nutre el vínculo. Cuando los conflictos se repiten y sienten que solos no logran salir del mismo círculo, la terapia de pareja puede ayudar; puedes conocer a los especialistas en línea de Selia cuando quieran dar el paso. Y si quieres una lectura rápida de cómo están, el test de pareja de Selia es un buen punto de partida. Preguntas Frecuentes ¿Una relación sana no tiene conflictos? Al contrario, los conflictos son normales y hasta saludables. Lo que distingue a una relación sana no es la ausencia de discusiones, sino la forma de manejarlas: buscando entenderse en lugar de ganar, sin insultos ni castigos. Una pareja que nunca discute a veces esconde temas evitados, no necesariamente una relación más sana. ¿Se puede convertir una relación poco sana en una sana? En muchos casos, sí, siempre que ambos estén dispuestos a trabajarlo. Cambiar patrones de comunicación, reconstruir la confianza y aprender a poner límites es posible con esfuerzo mutuo y, a veces, con apoyo profesional. Lo que difícilmente cambia es una relación donde hay maltrato o donde solo una persona quiere mejorar; ahí conviene priorizar tu seguridad. ¿Qué diferencia hay entre autonomía y desconexión? La autonomía es conservar tu espacio, tus amistades e intereses mientras sigues conectado emocionalmente con tu pareja. La desconexión, en cambio, es distancia emocional: dejan de compartir, de apoyarse o de interesarse el uno por el otro. Una relación sana equilibra ambas cosas: cercanía sin fusión, independencia sin abandono. ¿Es normal no sentir todas estas señales todo el tiempo? Sí, completamente. Ninguna relación exhibe las doce señales de forma perfecta y constante. Hay épocas de más tensión, cansancio o distancia. Lo importante es la tendencia general y la disposición a reparar cuando algo falla. Ver estas señales como una guía, no como un examen, ayuda a fortalecer el vínculo sin exigirle perfección. ¿Cuándo conviene ir a terapia de pareja? Cuando los mismos conflictos se repiten sin resolverse, cuando la comunicación se vuelve hostil o distante, o cuando ambos sienten que quieren mejorar pero no saben cómo. No hace falta estar al borde de la ruptura: la terapia de pareja también sirve para fortalecer una relación que va bien y quiere cuidarse mejor. Conclusión: Lo Sano También se Aprende Saber cómo se ve una relación sana es el primer paso para construir una. No se trata de perfección, sino de una base de confianza, respeto y comunicación donde ambos pueden ser quienes son. Si tu relación tiene muchas de estas señales, cuídalas: no se sostienen solas. Y si le faltan algunas, recuerda que casi todas se pueden cultivar con voluntad de ambos y algo de práctica. El conflicto no es el enemigo de una relación sana; la forma de atravesarlo es lo que marca la diferencia. Y si sienten que solos dan vueltas en el mismo lugar, buscar acompañamiento no es señal de fracaso, sino de cuánto les importa el vínculo. Nota importante : Este artículo tiene fines informativos y no reemplaza el consejo de un profesional de salud mental. Si en tu relación hay maltrato o temes por tu seguridad, busca apoyo especializado. En Colombia puedes comunicarte con la Línea 155 de orientación a mujeres víctimas de violencia.

title: 7 best AI visibility tracking tools for agencies by need
summary: The best AI visibility tracking tools for agencies include Semrush, OtterlyAI, and Peec AI. Here’s why.
body_text: The best AI visibility tracking tools for agencies are the ones that help you effortlessly monitor AI visibility across multiple clients. Even better if the tool goes beyond measuring visibility and offers features for improving it. In this guide, I’ve shortlisted seven AI visibility tools worth considering for your agency. Where possible, I tested them personally to assess their key strengths, limitations, and the agency need they’re best for. How to choose the right AI visibility tool for your marketing agency To choose the right AI visibility tool for your marketing agency, shortlist options based on agency-relevant factors like: Cost at scale : The sustainability of the tool’s pricing as you add team member seats, client projects, tracking coverage, and other capabilities Multi-client monitoring : Whether the tool lets you set up a dedicated workspace for each client, so each client’s data stays separate for cleaner monitoring Actionable recommendations : Whether the tool includes suggestions for improving AI visibility in addition to tracking it AI search platform coverage : The number of AI search platforms the tool tracks visibility for — and the specific platforms it tracks White-label reporting : Whether the tool facilitates creating reports with your and your clients’ branding and integrates with dedicated reporting tools Some factors may matter more depending on your agency’s size. For example, agencies with tighter budgets may prioritize cost at scale, whereas large agencies with enterprise rosters often look for broad AI search platform coverage to meet extensive client needs. Best AI visibility tools for marketing agencies at a glance Here’s a summary of the best AI visibility tools for marketing agencies, including their agency-specific strengths: AI visibility tool Best for Key strengths Pricing Semrush Agencies that offer both AI visibility monitoring and improvement suggestions - Actionable recommendations - Multi-client monitoring - White-label reporting - AI Visibility Toolkit : $99/month per domain - Enterprise AIO : Custom pricing OtterlyAI Budget-conscious agencies adding AI visibility tracking to their service offerings - Multi-client monitoring - Pitch environment - Agency partner program availability - Lite : $29/month - Standard : $189/month - Premium : $489/month - Enterprise : Custom pricing Peec AI Agencies with fluctuating client rosters and tracking needs - Cost at scale - AI search platform coverage - Pitch environment - Essential : Starts at $245/month - Growth : Starts at $495/month - Scale : Starts at $795/month - Comprehensive : Custom pricing AthenaHQ Agencies actively growing their client roster - Agency partner program availability - Content optimization - White-label reporting - Essential : Free - Starter : $295/month - Enterprise : Custom pricing Profound Large agencies offering comprehensive AI visibility management services - Content automation - Pitch environment - AI search platform coverage - Agency Growth : $99/month - Agency Enterprise : Custom pricing Scrunch Agencies that deliver custom client reports covering AI visibility and other performance metrics - White-label reporting - Pitch environment - Content optimization - Agency Core : $500/month - Enterprise : Custom pricing Brandlight Large agencies managing AI visibility for enterprise clients - Agency partner program availability - Co-pitching opportunities - Site audits - Custom pricing Now, let’s review each AI search visibility tool in more detail. 1. Semrush Semrush is an all-in-one online visibility platform that helps agencies monitor and improve their clients’ prominence in AI systems. Semrush’s AI Visibility Toolkit gives small-to-medium-sized agencies insight into their clients’ visibility and brand perception across AI search platforms, while Enterprise AIO offers large agencies broader, more comprehensive tracking for multi-market clients. When I entered a brand’s domain into the AI Visibility Toolkit’s Visibility Overview report, it took less than three seconds to return data on the brand’s mentions, citations, and cited pages. I also viewed how mentions were distributed by country. The “Topics & Sources” section in Visibility Overview provides information on: Performing topics : Topics and prompts yielding AI answers that mention my entered brand Topic opportunities : Topics and prompts yielding AI answers that mention competitors but not my entered brand Cited sources : The domains cited in AI answers mentioning my entered brand Source opportunities : The domains cited in AI answers mentioning competitors but not my entered brand Cited pages : The pages on my entered brand’s website that AI systems cited in answers The AI Visibility Toolkit also includes Brand Performance , which tells you about your brand’s share of voice and user sentiment toward it. The Brand Performance report additionally provides strategy recommendations categorized by urgency. These insights are useful for improving user and AI perception of your brand. An AI Visibility Toolkit subscription lets you generate two PDF reports combining data from Semrush and other analytics tools. Add-ons for extra reports and white-labeling are available. Semrush Enterprise AIO is the platform’s offering for agencies needing enterprise-grade AI visibility tracking. Pulling from a market-leading database of over 289M prompts, Enterprise AIO monitors visibility across 11 AI search platforms. It also provides AI Automations that help agencies with forecasting, auditing content, analyzing URLs driving negative sentiment, and more. For example, the Brand Strengths & Weaknesses AI Automation audits AI systems’ perception of your clients’ brands to highlight strengths and areas for improvement. And recommend next steps for closing gaps. Enterprise AIO tracks anywhere from 500 to 15,000 prompts per month depending on your specific setup. In contrast, the AI Visibility Toolkit tracks up to 25 prompts by default, with extra prompts available as an add-on. Best for Semrush is best for agencies that offer both AI visibility monitoring and improvement suggestions. Key strengths Actionable recommendations : Get guidance on improving how users and AI perceive client brands Multi-client monitoring : Run the AI Visibility Toolkit’s Visibility Overview report for an unlimited number of clients. Enterprise AIO offers projects for keeping each client’s AI visibility data separate and ready to view anytime. White-label reporting : AI Visibility Toolkit users can generate custom-branded reports for clients with a paid add-on. Enterprise AIO includes white-label reporting. Limitations While the AI Visibility Toolkit lets you set up client profiles in the Brand Performance reports, you need to run the Visibility Overview report every time you want to view a client’s holistic mention and citation data. Pricing AI Visibility Toolkit : $99/month per domain. A seven-day free trial is available. White-labeled PDF reports are available via the $20/month My Reports Pro add-on. Enterprise AIO : Custom pricing Refer to AI Visibility Toolkit pricing and Enterprise AIO pricing for more information. 2. OtterlyAI OtterlyAI provides one of the most budget-friendly solutions for tracking AI visibility across AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews , and Perplexity. Agency features include unlimited client workspaces and increased prompt limits. These features are available from the second pricing tier (Standard) onward, which also offers unlimited team members and reports. At $189/month, this plan’s price point is highly competitive compared to similar AI brand visibility tools on this list. To generate an AI visibility report with OtterlyAI, I gave the AI visibility tool information on a brand’s site, target country and language, competitors, and relevant prompts to track. It then took one and a half minutes to create a comprehensive report containing information like: Brand coverage over time : The percentage of prompts yielding answers that mention the brand and competitors over time Brand mentions : The number of times the entered brand and competitors appeared in AI answers for tracked prompts Top prompts by brand mentions : The prompts contributing the most mentions of the entered brand in AI answers Citations : The URLs that AI search platforms cite in their answers to tracked prompts OtterlyAI also generated AI visibility recommendations that I could act on directly or pass along to clients. Best for OtterlyAI is best for budget-conscious agencies adding AI visibility tracking to their service offerings. Key strengths Multi-client monitoring : Create workspaces to track visibility for individual clients separately. Users on the Standard plan or higher can create unlimited workspaces. Pitch environment : OtterlyAI agency partners can set up temporary workspaces to run AI visibility audits for prospects Agency partner program availability : OtterlyAI’s Agency Partner program provides access to agency features like increased prompt limits, pitch environments, co-selling opportunities, and a partner directory listing. You need to sign up for the Standard or Premium plan to qualify for the program. Limitations OtterlyAI lacks native white-label reporting. As a workaround, users on the Standard plan or higher can integrate the tool with Google Data Studio (formerly known as Google Looker Studio) to create branded reports. Pricing Lite : $29/month. A seven-day free trial is available. Standard : $189/month Premium : $489/month Enterprise : Custom pricing All plans include tracking for ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot. Google AI Mode , Gemini, and Claude tracking are paid add-ons with prices that differ by model, your base plan, and your billing interval. For example, Google AI Mode costs $9/month on monthly billing for Lite plan users. 3. Peec AI Peec AI is an AI SEO tool that provides flexible AI visibility tracking across multiple client projects and up to 11 AI search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. Peec AI’s plans operate on a credit allocation model, where each credit covers one tracked prompt per model per day. Agencies can assign these credits across client projects and AI search platforms to match clients’ needs. For example, Growth plan users who sign up for 25,000 monthly credits can use them to track 833 daily ChatGPT prompts or 416 daily prompts split across ChatGPT and Google AI Mode. When creating a client project in one of Peec AI’s agency plans I provided information like a brand URL, location, language, products and services, target markets, audience distribution, and relevant topics and prompts. I also set up the number of prompts to track daily and my target AI search platforms. After about 80 seconds, Peec AI generated data like: The brand’s AI visibility compared to competitors The source websites that AI systems cite in answers to my tracked prompts Brand mentions and citation sources for AI answers to my tracked prompts The domains that mention competitors but not my entered brand I reconfigured the report with the tabs at the top to measure my entered brand’s AI visibility against just one competitor. I also narrowed the report to prompts matching certain intents or topics. Best for Peec AI is best for agencies with fluctuating client rosters and tracking needs. Key strengths Cost at scale : Peec AI’s agency plans include unlimited users and client seats. This AI visibility tool’s pricing also uses a credit allocation model, letting you flexibly assign credits across client projects to match their tracking needs. AI search platform coverage : Peec AI’s tracking coverage is one of the most extensive in the market. Essential and Growth plan users can track visibility on up to six AI search platforms. Users on higher plans can track visibility on up to 11 platforms, including less common ones like DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral. Pitch environment : Create pitch projects that remain active for seven days and don’t use your monthly credit quota Limitations While there’s a beta recommendations feature for improving visibility, Peec AI is primarily a tracking-focused tool. Pricing Essential : Starts at $245/month for 10,000 credits Growth : Starts at $495/month for 25,000 credits Scale : Starts at $795/mo for 65,000 credits Comprehensive : Custom pricing with unlimited credits Seven-day free trials of the Essential, Growth, and Scale plans are available. 4. AthenaHQ AthenaHQ helps agencies monitor and grow clients’ AI visibility across nine AI systems, and it also offers opportunities for client referrals and volume discounts. I set up tracking for one brand in AthenaHQ by providing details like the brand’s domain, country, prompts, and competitors. I also selected the AI systems I wanted to track visibility for and configured my monitoring schedule. In about six and a half minutes, AthenaHQ analyzed AI responses to 10 prompts and generated information on metrics like: Share of voice : How often AI systems mention my entered brand relative to competitors. The platform also breaks down share of voice by model and tracks its daily trend. Mention rate and citation rate : How often AI systems mention and cite my entered brand in answers Citation sources : The sources contributing to AI mentions Brand traits : My entered brand’s visibility for positive and negative business traits against competitors After that, I navigated to AthenaHQ’s “Content” tab and had the tool’s content agents write new content targeting my tracked prompts. These agents can also optimize existing articles and recreate competitors’ top-performing content. I then clicked the “Outreach” subtab under “Content” to view potential third-party sites for getting coverage on — to improve AI visibility. Best for AthenaHQ is best for agencies actively growing their client roster, because the tool may send leads to its partner agencies. Key strengths Agency partner program availability : AthenaHQ’s three-tiered agency partner program is one of the most extensive. Partners enjoy onboarding support and potentially discounted pricing as they onboard more clients to the platform. AthenaHQ may also refer qualified leads. Content optimization : AthenaHQ offers content agents that can help produce and optimize content for AI visibility Shopify integration : Shopify store owners can use AthenaHQ’s native Shopify integration to track AI search’s impact on sales Limitations Multi-country support is available only on AthenaHQ’s Enterprise plan, whereas various competing tools offer it on lower-tier plans. Pricing Essential : Free Starter : $295/month Enterprise : Custom pricing 5. Profound Profound offers AI visibility tracking across nine AI search platforms at pricing that makes it more suitable for agencies with larger budgets. The Agency Growth plan includes 10 pitch workspaces and costs $99/month, but it requires a $399/month add-on per complete client workspace. As a result, agencies intending to use Profound can expect to pay at least $498/month. I encountered difficulty securing a trial or demo, so I evaluated Profound using the information on its main website and knowledge base. Profound’s Answer Engine Insights dashboard lets you view AI visibility scores for brands across AI systems and compare them against competitors’ scores. You can also track each brand’s share of voice. Image source : Profound The dashboard’s “Prompts” tab displays your tracked prompts. Which you can sort by visibility score to focus on prompts where your clients lack visibility. The “Citations” tab shows the top domains and URLs that AI systems cite in answers to tracked prompts. Profound organizes the domains into source categories like “Owned,” “Earned Media,” and “Social” to help you identify the types AI favors. Best for Profound is best for large agencies offering comprehensive AI visibility management services. Key strengths Content automation : Profound lets you build AI agents that automate content processes, including refreshing content and generating FAQ sections, to improve AI visibility Pitch environment : Create trial workspaces to track up to 25 prompts as you pitch prospects. The Agency Growth plan includes 10 trial workspaces that are active for seven days by default. AI search platform coverage : Agency Enterprise users can monitor prompts on nine AI search platforms, including Claude, Meta AI, and Grok. Users on the Agency Growth plan are limited to three. Limitations Profound’s agency pricing effectively starts at $498/month, making it less accessible for agencies on tighter budgets. Pricing Agency Growth : $99/month. Add client workspaces for $399/mo each. Add five trial workspaces for $199/month. Agency Enterprise : Custom pricing 6. Scrunch Scrunch tracks metrics like citations, sentiment, and topic-level visibility, and then helps agencies feed this data into custom client reports. I had Scrunch generate an AI visibility report for 20 prompts by entering a brand’s domain and refining the tool’s suggested primary country, persona, competitors, and topics. Scrunch took about 20 minutes to generate visibility data for the first five prompts. This data included: Citations : My entered brand’s percentage of AI citations against competitors and citation share of voice for tracked prompts. I also viewed the domains and URLs that AI cited when answering these prompts, as well as a proprietary “influence score” that measures each domain or URL’s prominence in citations. Performance for non-branded prompts : The brands with the highest visibility for non-branded prompts, plus sentiment toward my entered brand and where its citations appeared for these prompts Sentiment trends : Breakdowns of positive and negative sentiment toward my entered brand and the average sentiment over time Topics : How often AI systems mention my entered brand and the average sentiment toward it for my tracked topics I could also create custom in-platform dashboard widgets with the wide variety of metrics, filters, and breakdown parameters available. Scrunch’s built-in Agent Experience Platform lets you create AI-optimized versions of clients’ pages. These pages may give AI agents a more in-depth understanding of your clients’ brands to surface them more often. Best for Scrunch is best for agencies that deliver custom client reports covering AI visibility and other performance metrics. Key strengths White-label reporting : Scrunch offers application programming interface (API) options to facilitate custom report generation Pitch environment : Create pitch workspaces to generate AI visibility reports for prospects. Prospects also get licenses to try Scrunch for themselves before signing with you. Content optimization : Scrunch’s Agent Experience Platform optimizes site content for AI agents, helping these agents understand and surface the brand Limitations While Scrunch supports nine AI search platforms, only four are available on the lower-tiered Agency Core plan. Smaller agencies may find that plan’s $500/month price point less attractive as a result. Pricing Agency Core : $500/month. A seven-day free trial is available. Enterprise : Custom pricing 7. Brandlight Brandlight is an enterprise-grade AI visibility management tool used by large, established agencies like Sloane & Company, Publicis Groupe, and LLYC. Brandlight declined my request for a demo. So, I relied on its website to learn about its capabilities. Brandlight supports visibility tracking across more than 107,000 locations, ranging from broad regions to specific locales. It provides insights into the overall visibility of brands and their sub-brands across AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. Brandlight also compares your visibility against competitors’. Image source : Brandlight Brandlight analyzes prompts to identify their intent, whether they mention your brand, and the websites that AI systems cite when answering them. Agencies that partner with Brandlight can enjoy access to an AI strategist and co-pitching opportunities, among other benefits. Best for Brandlight is best for large agencies managing AI visibility for enterprise clients. Key strengths Agency partner program availability : Brandlight’s partner program includes co-pitching and co-selling opportunities, access to an AI strategist, and 24/7 support Co-pitching opportunities : Brandlight co-pitches with agencies, providing custom data to help close enterprise-level deals Site audits : You can run technical audits in Brandlight to identify and implement fixes that help AI agents crawl your site more effectively Limitations Customer reviews indicate that Brandlight lacks a reporting integration, which may make it harder for agencies to generate reports compiling data from multiple sources. Pricing Brandlight offers custom pricing tailored to each customer’s requirements. Start managing your clients’ AI visibility Our analysis above should give you a good idea of the best AI search monitoring tool for managing your clients’ visibility. But before you financially commit, try the tool or get a demo to confirm you’re making the right decision. Semrush’s seven-day free trial lets you test the SEO + AI Visibility Toolkit, which offers features for tracking and improving AI visibility, monitoring search engine visibility, and optimizing content for AI and Google. If you’re from a large agency and have more complex needs, book a demo to explore how Semrush’s Enterprise AIO delivers the extensive AI visibility tracking your clients seek. Share Alex Lindley Alex is a managing editor with 10+ years of experience leading content and SEO teams across SaaS, tech, ecommerce, and digital publishing. He specializes in building editorial systems that balance human judgment with AI-assisted workflows, helping teams produce original, high-impact content as search and discovery evolve. His work spans SEO strategy, content quality frameworks, and adapting content operations for AI-driven search.

title: Livestream Ediscovery: The Complete Guide
summary: Learn how to preserve and collect livestream ESI, navigate the unique challenges live video presents, and apply best practices for defensible ediscovery.
body_text: A single corporate livestream can generate a dozen distinct data sets in under an hour — and delete half of them automatically the moment the broadcast ends. From real-time product drops on social media to unscripted executive statements during internal town halls, live video has fast-tracked its way onto the litigation radar. This article breaks down the complexities of livestream electronically stored information (ESI) , explores the unique collection and authentication challenges it creates, and provides a step-by-step framework for court-approved livestream ediscovery. Understanding ESI from livestreams The global live streaming market was about $87.55 billion in 2023, growing at roughly 23% per year . It is projected to reach $416.84 billion by 2030 , driven largely by business use in marketing, events, and ecommerce. It’s essential for teams to understand the technology, the data it produces, and where that data is stored. Livestream platforms When livestreams contain discoverable evidence, legal teams must look across a highly fragmented ecosystem of platforms. These platforms can generally be placed into one of four broad categories: Enterprise broadcasting & virtual conferencing: Platforms like Zoom , Microsoft Teams , Webex, and GoToWebinar are routinely used for internal corporate town halls, board meetings, and external B2B webinars. Social media & public streaming: Social platforms such as YouTube Live, Facebook Live, Instagram Live, and LinkedIn Live are the primary venues for brand announcements, executive statements, and public relations campaigns. Gaming & community platforms: Twitch and Discord host highly interactive streams that are increasingly relevant in intellectual property, defamation, and consumer class action lawsuits. Live commerce platforms: Apps like TikTok Shop, Amazon Live, and specialized platforms like Whatnot host continuous commercial broadcasts where real-time product claims and transactions occur simultaneously. Need a quick overview of the ediscovery process? What Is Ediscovery? A Guide to Understanding Electronic Discovery Types of interaction data A single live event can simultaneously generate video feeds, interactive chat logs, and audience metrics across multiple infrastructures. When litigation is reasonably anticipated, teams must identify all associated metadata and interaction data: ‍ How livestream data is stored Livestream data is usually distributed across three distinct layers of infrastructure: Platform cloud infrastructure: The primary video file and associated metadata typically reside on the host platform's servers (e.g., AWS buckets for Twitch, or Microsoft Azure for Teams). Third-party integration tools: Many enterprises use specialized software to handle live captioning, chat moderation, or audience analytics. These tools may store independent copies of chat transcripts and viewer metrics. User and creator devices: Local cached files, temporary internet data, and local recording backups can often be found on the broadcaster’s computer or the smartphones of individual participants. The challenges of livestream ESI for ediscovery Traditional ediscovery workflows were built for static documents stored on hard drives. Livestreams, by their very nature, disrupt these standard protocols. Here is why live video data creates an immediate headache for legal teams. Ephemeral delivery and auto-deletion The greatest threat to livestream evidence is its inherent ephemerality. Many platforms are designed around temporary content delivery. Once a broadcast ends, the live video feed may vanish into thin air. Even on enterprise platforms, IT retention policies often dictate the automatic deletion of unarchived webinar recordings or associated chat logs within 30 to 90 days. If a legal hold is not placed immediately, the core evidence can be permanently lost. Get the guide : Ediscovery for Ephemeral Messaging: The Complete Guide Multi-platform simulcasting Modern marketing and public relations teams rarely stream to just one place. Using tools like Restream or Switchboard, a single live presentation can be broadcast simultaneously to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (formerly Twitter). This multi-platform approach complicates scoping and collection. Each platform generates its own independent sets of chat logs, viewer metadata, and compression algorithms, forcing legal teams to collect and reconcile multiple distinct datasets for a single live event. Real-time chat and engagement data A livestream video means very little without the context of the live chat happening alongside it. Capturing a video file is relatively simple, but preserving a fast-moving, real-time chat log — complete with emojis, hyperlinked text, deleted messages, and user reactions — is incredibly complex. If you separate the video from the chat, you lose the temporal context required to understand why a particular statement was made or how the audience received it. Platform access and legal process When data resides with third-party social media or streaming platforms, obtaining it directly through standard legal channels is notoriously difficult. Tech giants are protected by the Stored Communications Act (SCA), which strictly limits their ability to disclose user content to civil litigants. Relying on a third-party subpoena to get a deleted livestream from a platform is a low-probability strategy. The data must almost always be preserved and collected directly from the account owner. Dive deeper : Ediscovery for the Internet of Things (IoT): The Complete Guide Authentication and deepfake risk With the explosive rise of generative AI, authenticating video evidence has become a critical battleground in modern litigation. Standard MP4 native video exports can be easily manipulated or altered after the fact. Proving that a livestream recording is an exact, unaltered reflection of what originally aired requires an ironclad chain of custody, exact cryptographic hashing, and deep metadata preservation to withstand aggressive deepfake or spoliation challenges in court. Privilege exposure Internal corporate livestreams — such as a company-wide Q&A with the CEO — are frequently treated with a high degree of informality. Executives may speak candidly about pending litigation, proprietary product pipelines, or sensitive financial data. However, if external vendors, contractors, or unauthorized third parties are present on the stream, any claim to the attorney-client privilege is immediately waived. Legal teams must carefully review these internal streams since casual live remarks can easily become discoverable smoking guns. Related reading : Ediscovery 101: Guide to Ediscovery Rules and Best Practices Ediscovery process for livestreams Successfully managing livestream evidence requires adapting the standard Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) to accommodate dynamic, time-sensitive multimedia. How to preserve livestream evidence Preservation must happen the moment litigation is reasonably anticipated. Because platforms auto-delete content quickly, issuing a standard written legal hold to custodians is rarely enough. Legal teams must take active steps to ensure the data is not modified or purged. Before any automated cleanup scripts are run, account administrators should be instructed to: Disable auto-delete policies. Pause automated IT retention schedules. Secure the raw, uncompressed cloud recordings immediately within the host platform’s administrative console. Need a proven solution for legal holds? DISCO Hold enables in-place preservation with a single click. Livestream data collection Collecting livestream data requires balancing technical accessibility with evidentiary integrity. The specific collection methodology depends on two primary variables: administrative access and platform architecture. When legal teams have direct administrative credentials, they can utilize targeted API collections. This approach pulls raw video files, complete JSON metadata, and comprehensive chat logs directly from the platform’s backend infrastructure. In this scenario, hold-to-collect workflows can be streamlined with centralized cloud collection that preserves and gathers data directly from its source. Conversely, if evidence must be gathered from a public stream or an adversarial account where backend access is impossible, teams must rely on specialized forensic web crawlers. These tools perform a targeted capture of the live playback environment, preserving the exact visual layout, timing context, and interactive elements as they appeared to viewers. Ultimately, scoping the collection requires identifying all derivative data sets — including synchronized audio tracks, platform-specific emojis, and side-channel chat applications — to ensure no contextual gaps remain in the collected ESI. Livestream collection methodology ‍ Administrative access is available Administrative access is not available Approach API Collection Forensic Capture Execution Pulls raw video files, complete JSON metadata, and comprehensive chat logs directly from the platform backend. Deploys specialized web crawlers to capture the live playback environment, preserving visual layout and timing context. ‍ Dive deeper : Legal Hold Best Practices: A Process Guide ‍ Processing and review of livestream ESI Once collected, the raw files must be prepared for human review. Processing a livestream means syncing the audio track with the visual timeline and the interactive chat log. Legal teams should utilize advanced ediscovery platforms to run automated audio transcription, turning spoken words into searchable text. Furthermore, review workflows must allow attorneys to search simultaneously across the synchronized video transcript and the interactive chat logs, so a keyword hit in the text chat jumps directly to the exact millisecond in the video playback when that chat occurred. For example, DISCO processes video files at ingest to extract available metadata and provides an enhanced media player for review — with full controls. Ediscovery best practices for livestreams These four best practices can help teams do ediscovery for livestreams in a way that withstands judicial scrutiny. 1. Act immediately when livestream evidence is anticipated Treat livestream data with the same urgency as an expiring text message or ephemeral Slack communication. Do not wait for formal discovery requests to arrive from opposing counsel. If a live broadcast is relevant to a dispute, initiate your preservation and collection workflows immediately before platform logs roll over or corporate account settings purge the data. 2. Use forensic collection tools, not native exports The native export capabilities of most platforms may strip out critical system metadata, alter file creation dates, and separate the video file from the associated chat log. Always use specialized forensic collection tools that generate a verifiable cryptographic hash (such as MD5 or SHA-256) and capture the entire metadata payload to guarantee data integrity – or partner with an expert team like DISCO Forensics to ensure defensible preservation. 3. Include livestream platforms in legal hold and ESI protocols Update your organizational data maps and standard ESI protocols to explicitly include live video channels. When drafting litigation hold notices, ensure that platforms like Twitch, Zoom, and YouTube Live are listed alongside traditional sources like email and local hard drives. This ensures your custodians identify and protect any local or cloud-based backups of live broadcasts early in the case. 4. Engage forensic partners with platform-specific expertise Every streaming platform relies on a different underlying architecture. The API architecture used to pull data from a Microsoft Teams Town Hall is entirely different from the web scraping methods required to defensibly capture a TikTok Live commerce stream. Work with specialized forensic collection partners who understand these platform-specific nuances and can build collection packages that withstand strict authentication challenges. Mastering ediscovery for livestreams Livestreams are an incredibly powerful medium for modern business, but they represent a highly volatile category of ESI. Because this content is inherently ephemeral, multi-layered, and distributed across complex cloud infrastructures, legal teams cannot afford to rely on outdated, static collection methods. Embracing automated processing, specialized forensic tools, and an immediate response timeline is the only way to ensure your evidence remains defensible. title: Cómo calcular el ReteICA paso a paso
summary: Para calcular el ReteICA debes verificar primero si el pago supera la base mínima definida por el municipio, identificar la tarifa según la actividad económica del proveedor (código CIIU)
body_text: Para calcular el ReteICA debes verificar primero si el pago supera la base mínima definida por el municipio, identificar la tarifa según la actividad económica del proveedor (código CIIU) y aplicar esa tarifa sobre el valor de la operación antes de IVA. El resultado es el valor que debes retener al proveedor y declarar después ante la Secretaría de Hacienda municipal. Qué es el ReteICA El ReteICA (Retención en la Fuente del Impuesto de Industria y Comercio) no es un impuesto en sí mismo, sino un mecanismo de recaudo anticipado del ICA. Cuando una empresa (agente retenedor) le paga a un proveedor, descuenta un porcentaje de ese pago y lo entrega directamente al municipio, en lugar de que el proveedor tenga que pagar todo el ICA al final del periodo. Ese valor retenido funciona como un anticipo que el proveedor podrá descontar luego en su propia declaración de ICA. Al ser un impuesto de carácter municipal, las tarifas, bases mínimas y plazos varían de una ciudad a otra, por lo que siempre es necesario revisar el Estatuto Tributario del municipio donde se realiza la operación. Antes de calcular: qué debes verificar Antes de aplicar cualquier fórmula, confirma estos puntos: Que tu empresa esté registrada como agente retenedor de ICA ante el municipio correspondiente. Que la actividad del proveedor esté efectivamente gravada con ICA (no todas las actividades lo están). Que el pago o abono en cuenta supere la base mínima establecida por el municipio, generalmente expresada en UVT. Que conozcas el código CIIU de la actividad económica del proveedor, ya que de ahí depende la tarifa aplicable. Bases mínimas y tarifas de referencia por ciudad Estos valores son de referencia (UVT 2026 = $52.374) y deben confirmarse en el Estatuto Tributario de cada municipio, ya que pueden cambiar: Ciudad Base mínima servicios Base mínima compras Tarifa de referencia Bogotá 4 UVT ($209.496) 27 UVT ($1.414.098) Entre 4,14 ‰ y 13,8 ‰ según actividad Medellín 4 UVT ($209.496) 27 UVT ($1.414.098) Entre 2 ‰ y 10 ‰ según actividad Cali 4 UVT ($209.496) 27 UVT ($1.414.098) Entre 2 ‰ y 10 ‰ según actividad Barranquilla Definida por el municipio Definida por el municipio Tarifa única o diferencial, según ordenanza local Paso a paso para calcular el ReteICA Verifica si el pago supera la base mínima: consulta la base mínima vigente en el municipio (expresada en UVT) y compárala con el valor de la operación antes de IVA. Si el pago es inferior, no hay lugar a retención. Identifica la tarifa aplicable: ubica el código CIIU de la actividad económica del proveedor y busca la tarifa correspondiente en el Estatuto Tributario municipal. Calcula la retención: multiplica la base gravable (el valor del pago antes de IVA) por la tarifa, expresada por mil (‰). Practica la retención: descuenta el valor calculado del pago al proveedor en el momento del pago o abono en cuenta, lo que ocurra primero. Expide el certificado de retención: entrega al proveedor el soporte que acredite el valor retenido, para que pueda descontarlo en su propia declaración de ICA. Declara y paga: presenta la declaración de ReteICA dentro de los plazos del calendario tributario municipal (generalmente bimestral) y transfiere el valor total retenido en el periodo. Ejemplo práctico Una empresa en Bogotá le paga a un proveedor de servicios de consultoría $5.000.000 antes de IVA. La tarifa de ReteICA para esa actividad es de 9,66 ‰. Base gravable: $5.000.000 Tarifa: 9,66 ‰ (0,00966) Cálculo: $5.000.000 × 0,00966 = $48.300 La empresa retiene $48.300, le paga al proveedor $4.951.700 (más el IVA correspondiente) y declara ese valor retenido ante la Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá dentro del plazo establecido. Errores comunes al calcular el ReteICA Aplicar la tarifa sobre el valor total de la factura, incluyendo el IVA, en lugar de aplicarla solo sobre la base gravable. Usar la tarifa de un municipio distinto al de la jurisdicción donde realmente se presta el servicio o se realiza la venta. No verificar si el pago supera la base mínima antes de practicar la retención. Olvidar expedir el certificado de retención, lo que puede generar sanciones para el agente retenedor. No actualizar las bases mínimas y tarifas cuando cambia el valor de la UVT cada año. Calcular el ReteICA correctamente requiere verificar la base mínima, identificar la tarifa según la actividad económica y el municipio, aplicar esa tarifa sobre la base gravable antes de IVA, y cumplir con la declaración y el pago dentro de los plazos establecidos. Como se trata de un impuesto territorial, siempre es recomendable validar las reglas específicas del municipio antes de practicar cualquier retención, para evitar errores y sanciones.
